**Could this be a plugin?**

Please check `docs/PLUGIN-GUIDE.md` first. New backends, tools, domain ports
and coordination templates are meant to ship as plugins. If the plugin API
cannot express what you need, say which registration method or event is
missing — that is the most useful form of this request.

**Use case**

What you are building and what currently blocks it.

**Proposed shape**

If you have one. A signature sketch is enough.
